description: Estudio Valsain pone a la venta EN EXCLUSIVA fabuloso inmueble en una de las zonas más exclusivas y vibrantes de Lavapiés; la zona de Antón Martín. Estudio Valsain exclusively offers for sale a fabulous property in one of the most exclusive and vibrant areas of Lavapiés: the Antón Martín neighborhood. This spectacular exterior-facing home with ceilings over 4 meters high has been renovated down to the smallest detail. It boasts 111 square meters distributed across an extremely spacious living room facing the street, an open-plan kitchen fully furnished and equipped with top-brand appliances, two bedrooms, and two full bathrooms—one of them en-suite with a spacious walk-in shower, and the other with a bathtub, both ideal for meeting all your daily needs. The interior woodwork includes double-glazed Climalit windows, providing excellent thermal and acoustic insulation. The home stays cool in the summer and warm in the winter, and it also features gas radiators in every room, split air conditioning units with both cooling and heating functions, and ceiling fans. The floors are porcelain tile with a wood finish, and the walls are smooth. As for the location, it’s unbeatable—just steps away from supermarkets, pharmacies, a veterinary clinic, as well as leisure and cultural hotspots such as the renowned Antón Martín Market, the iconic Doré Cinema Film Archive, the Reina Sofía Museum of Contemporary Art, and the famous El Retiro Park. NO COMMISSION FOR THE BUYER. Don't miss the opportunity to visit this wonderful property—the home you’ve been searching for is waiting for you!
